# Generated Multi-View Car Functional Fixture

This fixture contains six synthetic views of the same distinctive blue compact
SUV at different nominal viewpoints and distances. It is intended to exercise
image decoding, multi-view input assembly, model execution, NDNSF named-Data
transport, result publication, and annotated-image retrieval without physical
cameras.

The images were generated on 2026-08-28 from one visual identity reference.
They do **not** provide calibrated camera intrinsics/extrinsics, exact metric
geometry, or real-world ground truth. Results from this fixture are functional
evidence only and must not be reported as real-flight recognition accuracy.

See `manifest.json` for view metadata and SHA-256 hashes.
